meta.title: Vendor e-mail when the event is withdrawn
gaps: Open the QA mailboxes and verify that each concerned vendor received exactly one withdrawal notice, while no other vendor or real supplier received one.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open the QA mailboxes and verify that each concerned vendor received exactly one withdrawal notice, while no other vendor or real supplier received one.

steps.note: Open an existing test event to perform the withdrawal.
Withdraw the entire event as required by the scenario.
Verify that Procol recorded the event as withdrawn.

args.need: open the QA mailboxes for the concerned vendors and verify exactly one withdrawal notice for each, with no message to other vendors or real suppliers

steps.note: Mailbox access and email delivery inspection are not available in the catalog.
Confirm the final browser state has no visible application errors after the mailbox verification request.
